question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) AS month_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
positive_balance_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        COUNT(*) AS positive_balance_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month_year
),
month_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        positive_balance_count
    FROM positive_balance_counts
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month_year 
    FROM month_counts 
    WHERE positive_balance_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_balance_count) FROM month_counts)
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month_year 
    FROM month_counts 
    WHERE positive_balance_count = (SELECT MIN(positive_balance_count) FROM month_counts)
),
highest_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances mb
    WHERE mb.month_year IN (SELECT month_year FROM highest_month)
),
lowest_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances mb
    WHERE mb.month_year IN (SELECT month_year FROM lowest_month)
),
result AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM highest_avg) as highest_avg_balance,
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM lowest_avg) as lowest_avg_balance,
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM highest_avg) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM lowest_avg) AS difference
)
SELECT * FROM result
